notes.title: First Light: Patch Notes 07/07/2023
notes.content:
Hello Cosmic Voyagers,

Firstly, a heartfelt salute from the bridge to all our brave captains who have embraced A Long Journey to an Uncertain End. Your support has given us the fuel to keep this ship rocketing through the cosmic narrative we've all come to cherish.

As with any daring voyage into the unknown, there are always a few stray asteroids that need blasting. 

C.O.R.G.I.'s been listening in and ze helped us stomp some of the reported bugs. Here's a look at what's getting a tune-up:


 Fixed time progression issues: Timer wasn't pausing when the game was paused , when the Settings menu was open , nor when the crew screen was open.
 Adjusted music default volume to start at 60% instead of 100%
 Fixed pronouns displaying for NPCs
 Small credit fixes


Keep those observations, bug reports, and improvements coming - they're the key to making this game the best it can be. For those eager to share their experiences and ideas in more detail, hop into our Discord channel, the perfect space station for in-depth conversations on the game.

A hearty thank you, Captains, for your commitment to this interstellar adventure.

Fly safe,
Crispy Creative

notes.title: MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION
notes.content:
Content Warning
A Long Journey to An Uncertain End centers around your character escaping an abusive relationship with a past partner. Your ex (for whom you can choose a name and pronouns in-game) is pursuing you across the galaxy. If they catch up with you, the game ends. 

While no specifics are discussed about your past relationship with this person, it is clear that they were controlling and possibly even violent. In the game, they are actively stalking the protagonist with malicious intent, and will attempt to hack into their systems in a form of mind control or manipulation.

notes.title: Kickstarter Backer Surveys Sent!
notes.content:
Thank you for letting us take a (much needed) break. Now that we've gotten our space legs back we have updates!

Backer Surveys
The first and most immediate is our partnership with BackerKit for our reward fulfillment! All of our backers should have survey links in their emails (be sure to check spam folders!). We're using BackerKit to handle all our backer surveys for things like shipping information and reward questions.

You don't need to create a BackerKit account to fill out your survey. Just click on the survey link in your email, fill it out, and you're good to go! You'll also be able to up your pledge if you'd like (or include an add-on or two)!

We also have good news for those asking about being a late backer. For a limited time we've provided most of our pledge tiers in our BackerKit store! The same limits from the campaign still apply so if you have your eye on naming an NPC or becoming a character, grab it while it's still available!

Stretch Goal
Finally, we had a lot of interest in our last stretch goal of a Nintendo Switch version. After talking with the team we decided to keep the stretch goal open! So for those thinking of snagging an add-on or upping their pledge, it will still go towards our Nintendo Switch goal!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/9b5b6fa927e27c634ef29e8e1395ec8a03cd8a0d.png

Development Update
On the development side we've been busy collecting all the feedback from our backers, Discord channels, and livestreams. We also got a few very thorough and helpfully constructive evaluations from you all. Very much appreciated! Already your feedback has inspired the team with new ideas and updates which we're excited to share in the future.

That's all for now! Backers, check your emails for survey links! Late backers, check out our BackerKit store! Thank you all so much spacefarers. We could not have made it this far without you and we are so glad you're part of this adventure with us!

Be sure to join us, and our inclusive and lovely community on our socials!

Twitter: @CrispyCreative
Instagram: @crispycreativestudio
Facebook: Crispy Creative Studio
Come chat with us on our community Discord! http://bit.ly/LongJourneyDiscord

notes.title: We Are 100% And Still Have More News To Share
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/a724d60945a7f42050d4cf96340927bb2aa8c509.png 

One of the most fun and exciting things about hitting your funding goal in a Kickstarter campaign is then being able to announce some STRETCH GOALS!

We’d love to announce all of our stretch goals today, but unfortunately, we really want to keep you on your toes. So, with just three days to go before our Kickstarter campaign comes to a close, we’re only going to reveal our first two.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/0e86d96f32134d19d738033eec0228ce41ca0aba.png

First up:

$45k Funding sees the addition of THREE NEW PLANET TYPES for you to explore!


 CHAOS: Visit the brand new Chaos planet, an unsettling setting with unexplainable geological formations that your lovable crew might just not be prepared for.


 SPICE: The agricultural planet where unique, heavily coveted spices like Azure Saffron, Lunar Lavender, and more are produced. What could the crew be searching for here?


 GAS GIANT: Sounds dangerous, doesn’t it? Let’s hope C.O.R.G.I. isn’t the only one who makes it out in one piece…


$50k Funding sees the addition of TWO NEW CREW MEMBERS to add to your team!

Did you think we were done with our crew line-up? Not a chance. Truly, Aylah and the rest of the team will be joined by two more fascinating, lovable, diverse, and beautifully crafted crew members if we hit $50k funding by March 4th. Help us introduce the “Robot” and a mystery individual to the game, for we’d really love you to meet them!

Also, we've heard your calls and are super happy to introduce a new add-on that is available if you'd like to pre-order extra copies of the game for your friends, family, and corgis. Head over to our campaign page to check it out if you're so inclined!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/076c9c4a7e0548306a915e505ffcb16691ecf6b2.png

Next up, don't forget about the Live Q&A happening with our narrative team. Join us tomorrow (March 2nd) at 9 am PT / 5 pm GMT / 6 pm CET. We will be streaming here on Steam as well as on Twitch and YouTube.

notes.title: Skills in A Long Journey to an Uncertain End
notes.content:
Hey there! This is Kylan, the creative director at Crispy Creative. We’ve been very busy working on the game and can’t wait to share more progress with you. To start our very first Steam update, we wanted to go through some of the core system designs for Long Journey.

Know Your Strengths

Everyone is good at something, and your crew is no different. Each crew member has a skill they excel at. Currently, there are five main skills:

Deception, Seduction, Muscle, Business, and Tech.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/5d37fa62d20c5042b14f65c29afb6f832ffd7c31.png

Each skill is related to the other. So, someone who is great at Seduction is OK at Deception and Muscle, but terrible at Business and Tech.

Jobs

Most jobs you encounter will have a recommended skill. Gravotrometer needs repairing? Someone with the Tech skill would be best. Bodyguard needed? Some Muscle would probably be best.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/2d0601bcec31eaf88c2043d2e2a0563c4cf084e3.jpg

Aligning your crew’s skills with the job at hand is only the first step though. Successfully completing jobs may not be so obvious. Some job choices may require skills different than the obvious ones.

Aligning your crew’s skills with the job at hand is only the first step, though. Successfully completing jobs may not be so obvious. Some job choices may require skills different than the obvious ones. That bodyguard job needing Muscle before? When the client asks your crew to pose as their date, some Seduction or Deception skill would undoubtedly help. Get to know your crew, and they might surprise you. Hidden choices will be more obvious, the more your crew reveal themselves. Who knew Truly had a secret fascination with digital pets? Or that Zeke is also into holistic medicine? Or that Aylah is a closet fan of…wait, what? Oh she’d rather I not…ah, fine. You’ll have to ask her yourself! 😉
